sections.heading: Mohammed bin Salman Al Saud — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Mohammed bin Salman Al Saud was born on 31 August 1985 in Riyadh, and holds citizenship of Saudi Arabia.

Public records name his father, Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud and his mother, Fahdah bint Falah bin Hathlain Alajmi. He is a sibling of Sultan bin Salman Al Saud, Abdulaziz bin Salman, Ahmed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Fahd bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Faisal bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud and Turki bin Salman Al Saud.
His listed education includes King Saud University.
He is recorded as speaking Arabic and English.

sections.heading: Mohammed bin Salman Al Saud — Career and Professional Work
paras: Mohammed bin Salman Al Saud works primarily as a politician, with Bureau of Experts at the Saudi Council of Ministers listed among his employers.
Among the credits most often linked to Mohammed are Saudi Vision 2030.
He has held the following offices: Crown Prince of Saudi Arabia (2017–present).
He has taken part in 2018 G20 Buenos Aires summit and 2016 G20 Hangzhou summit.
